channel.title: Blow Your Mind
channel.desc: Dr Chris and Dr Xand bring you the top space experts on the planet to show you things that will truly Blow Your Mind! They investigate one of the biggest questions in the universe - are there aliens out there? Their friend, physicist Professor Brian Cox, explores the surface of Mars to find out if aliens could live there. And Brian heads to a giant ice cave to discover if alien life could survive in the coldest parts of our solar system.
